FN-KH7MHAU-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 360
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/09/2026
House Bill 360 as introduced would decrease annual sales tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by an estimated $386,000, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, by establishing an annual sales
tax holiday for ammunition, firearms, and hunting supplies.
This bill could also decrease receipts to county and municipal funds by an estimated $506,000
annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, if the respective local governments adopt the sales tax
holiday.

FN-KH7MHAU-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 360
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/07/2026
House Bill 360 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would
decrease annual sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $386,000,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2026 and ending in Fiscal Year 2029, by establishing an annual sales
tax holiday for ammunition, firearms, and hunting supplies.
This bill could also decrease receipts to county and municipal funds by an estimated $506,000
annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, if the respective local governments adopt the sales tax
holiday.
